ja: 『魔神創造伝ワタル』より二人の救世主がともに創りあげた究極の魔神「神龍王丸」が登場！■部位ごとにパーツを分けられるシリーズ共通フレームを採用。他の魔神と組み合わせて遊ぼう！■パチパチと手で外せるタッチゲート仕様。接着剤無しで組み立てられる！■両肩の双龍紋などはゴールドメタリックパーツで再現！■背中の神環光輪や神創龍剣はライトブルーのクリアパーツで再現！
en: From "Mashin Souzouden Wataru " comes the ultimate demon " Shinryuomaru" created by two saviors together! • Adopts a common frame across the series that allows parts to be separated by area. Let's play in combination with other genies! • Touch gate design that can be removed by hand. Can be assembled without adhesive! • The twin dragon crests on both shoulders are reproduced with gold metallic parts! • The divine ring halo and divine dragon sword on the back are reproduced with light blue clear parts!
